_comment: Outcome of a full human-in-the-loop visual review: all 6,581 original images were tiled into 264 numbered 5x5 contact sheets and inspected by 24 parallel reviewers, with every flagged cell then re-verified individually at full resolution. Only images whose MAIN SUBJECT is not the truck are excluded. Nothing is excluded for photographic quality - blur, darkness, blowout, mud, glare and bad framing are all retained deliberately.
